description: This file contains Kotlin code defining data classes and a parser object for processing 'TalkDirective' JSON objects embedded in text. It provides functionalities to parse directives, extract relevant fields, identify unknown keys, and handle JSON normalization. The core focus is on parsing structured voice directive configurations for an Android application.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Data class representing various configurable parameters for speech directives, such as voice ID, model ID, speed, language, and output format.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the parsing outcome, including the directive, the remaining text, and any unknown keys encountered.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParser
classes.description: Object containing static methods to parse a text block into a TalkDirective object and handle JSON content normalization and extraction.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the input text to identify and extract a TalkDirective JSON object, returning a result with the directive, remaining text, and unknown keys.

methods.name: parseJsonObject
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string line into a JsonObject, handling exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a JsonObject given a list of possible keys.

methods.description: Retrieves a Double value from a JsonObject given a list of possible keys.
